key_facts: Six steps from context to journal (docs/agents.md)
Agents run the packet loop without being asked when work is pending (docs/agents.md)
Claude Code hooks enforce it automatically (README.md)
Same protocol exposed via the MCP server tools (docs/agents.md)
summary:
The agent protocol is the six-step loop every integrated CLI follows: read the brief at session start and run the packet loop unasked if work is pending; query the graph for cross-cutting questions and cite edge ids; write durable knowledge back with remember, link and journal; grow the graph via growmos next → apply until it says up to date; fact-check claims with growmos check; journal at session end.

It lives in the AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md block, the Claude skill and Cursor rules, and is exposed as MCP tools; in Claude Code the SessionStart and Stop hooks enforce it automatically.
